title: Cool Icon
description: Atom Material Icons for Visual Studio Code (unofficial fork)

title: QueryDock - Database Client
description: Lightweight database client for VS Code. Browse schemas, run SQL, page results. Free: PostgreSQL, SQLite, H2-compatible HTTP, one connection, 500-row grid. Pro: MySQL/MariaDB, unlimited connections, 5000-row paging, CSV/JSON export, query favorites.

title: Tau Syntax Highlighter
description: Syntax highlighting support for the experimental Tau language.

title: FileMaker Clipboard Bridge
description: Copy and paste FileMaker scripts, steps, custom functions and more between FileMaker Pro and VS Code as XML, with a readable Script Workspace-style view.

title: Atom UI Colors
description: Keep VS Code's native UI icons and give them the Atom Material color palette. File icons stay independent.

title: Emkay Dev
description: Write an OpenVoiceOS skill and talk to it at once: Emkay runs next to your code, in VS Code – also in the browser (vscode.dev, github.dev).

title: Askama IntelliSense
description: Highlighting, navigation and completion for Askama templates in Rust projects.

title: Damn Is It Down
description: See in your status bar when GitHub, npm, AWS, Vercel, OpenAI or any service you use is down. Confirmed outages only. No account, no tracking.

title: Migration Atlas
description: SQL migration files: summary, destructive operations, tables. Pro: PostgreSQL lock-risk review and a rollback plan. Works offline.

title: RestMate - REST Client
description: Postman-style REST client in VS Code. Free: send HTTP requests, pretty JSON, last-10 history. Pro: collections, {{variable}} environments, curl import, .http export, unlimited history, response export, auth helpers.
